manifest.name: Updates
manifest.description: Checks GitHub for new KubeBench releases and shows what changed after an upgrade.

settings.title: Updates

mode.label: Update checks
mode.help: Which GitHub releases KubeBench tells administrators about. Off never contacts GitHub; use it for air-gapped installs.

current.label: Running version
current.unknown: A development build: it is not compared with releases.

latest.label: Latest release
latest.off: Not checked: update checks are off

settings.checkOff: Turn update checks on to check now.
settings.loadFailed: Could not load the update status

notices.upToDate: KubeBench v{{version}} is up to date.
notices.noReleases: No KubeBench releases are published yet.
notices.unknownCurrent: This is a development build. The latest release is v{{version}}.
notices.saveFailed: Could not save the update mode
notices.markSeenFailed: Could not remember that you have seen this version's changes

statusBar.tooltip: KubeBench v{{version}} is available. Click for the release notes and how to upgrade.

available.title: Update available
available.summary: KubeBench v{{latest}} is available. You are running v{{current}}.
available.backup: Back up first: KubeBench migrates its database when it starts, and an older version cannot open it again.

helm.title: Helm
helm.hint: Keeps your chart values on top of the new chart's defaults.

packages.title: .deb and .rpm packages
packages.hint: Download the new package from the release page; the configuration in /etc/kubebench is kept and the service restarts.

installer.title: install.sh
installer.hint: Running the installer again upgrades in place and keeps the configuration and data.

docker.title: Docker
docker.hint: Pull the new image, then recreate the container with the same volume.

whatsNew.title: What's new in v{{version}}
whatsNew.intro: Here is what changed in KubeBench v{{version}}.
whatsNew.introSince: KubeBench was updated from v{{from}} to v{{version}}. Here is what changed.
